data.name: TargetShooter
data.detailed_description:
Target Shooter is a casual shooting game designed for short, intense play sessions.

Players must dodge incoming missiles while shooting and destroying targets to earn points. The rules are simple but unforgiving: a single missile hit will immediately end the game, requiring constant focus and precise aiming.

As the game progresses, the number of incoming missiles increases, gradually raising the difficulty. Players are challenged to maintain concentration and quick reactions while pushing for higher scores.

Each play session lasts approximately 1 to 3 minutes, making it easy to replay the game multiple times. The game encourages repeated attempts as players aim to improve their scores with each run.

With simple controls and straightforward mechanics, Target Shooter is suitable for shooting game beginners as well as players who enjoy fast-paced, skill-based challenges.

Genre: Casual Shooting Game

Objective: Destroy targets and earn points

Play Mode: Single-player

Controls: Mouse and Keyboard

Average Play Time: Approximately 1–3 minutes per session
